explanation: Use the stored left-subtree size to compare k with the current root’s inorder rank. Descend left, return the root, or subtract the left subtree and root before descending right. The wrapper initializes subtree sizes.
timeComplexity: O(h) query time after O(n) wrapper size initialization.
spaceComplexity: O(1) query space; wrapper initialization uses O(h) recursion.
